findings.description: AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded in user_data. User data can be retrieved by privileged instance users and may be exposed through Terraform state or source control, allowing misuse of the credentials.
TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0, permitting SSH connection attempts from any internet host to the publicly addressed instance.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key, so data on this separately provisioned disk may be stored unencrypted at rest unless account-level defaults happen to enforce encryption.
This snapshot is created from an EBS volume that is not configured for encryption. It can therefore retain the disk contents without encryption at rest.
The bucket storing VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration, so sensitive network metadata may be written without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
